'''Somnrayna''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Souverelle]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Now has the control of the subconscious deep. If you found yourself transforming into a clump of seaweed last night, fear not--Somnrayna just wanted a bit more greenery!"

Somnrayna is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
